anti_ai_principles: No perfect symmetry. All elements must have intentional offset alignments (e.g., overlapping borders, mismatched left/right paddings).
Avoid standard pill badges or perfectly circular FABs. Use sharp geometric cuts, brutalist block shadows, or exposed grid lines.
Embrace negative space and typographic overlaps. Large numbers bleeding off the screen instead of small inline text.
Simulate designer tension: Use jagged, varying spacing. Do not use uniform gap-4 for everything. Mix gap-2 with gap-12 to create rhythm.
Containers must feel tactile, using heavy borders (border-b-4, border-r-4) instead of soft box-shadows.

hierarchy.background_count: text-[140px] font-heading leading-none tracking-tighter opacity-10 text-white absolute -top-8 -left-4 pointer-events-none
hierarchy.label: text-[10px] font-heading tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-neon-green

spacing_and_layout.stagger_gap: Every even card in a list should have a translate-y-4 offset.

map_base.style: A dark #0A0E14 base with a subtle grid pattern or topographic SVG background. No bright or standard map tiles. Completely stealth.

trainer_markers.style: Not standard teardrop pins. Use harsh square or diamond geometric nodes with glowing borders.
trainer_markers.anti_ai_detail: The inner initials should be slightly italicized and pushed off-center (e.g., translate-x-[1px] translate-y-[2px]) to feel raw.

available_now_row.layout: Horizontal scroll, floating 40px above the bottom edge. NOT flush. The first card has a heavy pl-8 margin.
available_now_row.card_style: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Top and left borders only (border-t border-l border-white/20) for a brutalist 3D effect. backdrop-blur-xl.
available_now_row.stagger_effect: Cards should not perfectly align. Odd cards are translateY(0), Even cards are translateY(-12px).

trainer_detail_popup.style: Occupies the top portion of the screen when a marker is tapped. Uses an asymmetrical layout with the trainer's image bleeding off the top edge.
trainer_detail_popup.border: Heavy 2px border on the bottom edge matching the trainer's status neon color.

recenter_button.style: A sharp rectangle sticking out from the right edge. border-y border-l border-white/20. No right border. The icon is a raw crosshair.

refresh_button.style: Brutalist block. border-b-2 border-r-2 border-neon-green bg-transparent hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:border-b-0 hover:border-r-0 transition-all px-4 py-2

user_location_dot.style: A pure white 4px square. Instead of a smooth ripple, it has a glitching, harsh radar burst animation (opacity switching abruptly).

animations.marker_glitch: slight random X/Y translations on hover to feel unstable and high-energy.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts: 'Anton' and 'Outfit' inside your global CSS.
Do NOT use standard rounded cards (rounded-xl, etc.). Implement sharp edges, asymmetrical borders (border-l, border-t), and raw brutalist geometry.

Implement the map as a relative mobile-sized container (e.g., max-w-md h-[850px] overflow-hidden). If map API isn't present, mock the map with a deep #0A0E14 background, a subtle CSS grid, and fixed marker nodes.
Trainer Count Badge must be implemented as a massive background typography element (h1) that bleeds off the screen with tracking-tighter and opacity-10.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive or distinct visual component as specified.
Never center the layout perfectly. If a column of text is left aligned, add an arbitrary padding to its container (like pl-6) to push it off-balance.
